description: Declarative catalog of environment variable secrets with consumer-scoped access control.

secrets.description: List of secret entries. Each maps a SOPS secret name to an env var, with optional consumer whitelist and SOPS source.

envVar.description: Environment variable name the service reads (e.g. KEY_AI_OPENROUTER, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

sopsSource.description: Which SOPS file contains the secret value.

consumers.description: Whitelist of service/module names that should receive this secret. Empty means declared but not wired.
